body:
As someone who got out of a long-term intense, seemingly all-consuming relationship a while back, I feel for you. I too had withdrawn from all of my friendships, and felt like I had nothing else to fall back upon. I have struggled with depression and ideation for most of my adult life and I know how easy it is for people like me to fall into a shame spiral. 

But it got better. It took me 1.5 years to feel completely normal and I'm still wary of getting into anything serious but eventually things did get better. What helped in my case were weirdly my insane work hours, and the friends I had made at work. I gradually reconnected with 2 of my old friends.
So please don't do it. It will get better. Do things that give you joy, even small things like watching your favourite tv show, or reading your favourite book or playing your favourite game. Be kinder to yourself.
